payload.description_html: Simplified cladogram of Avialae, based on T. Maryańska, H. Osmólska and M. Wolsan (2002) Avialan status for Oviraptorosauria <http://www.app.pan.pl/archive/published/app47/app47-097.pdf>. Acta Palaeontologica Polonica. 47(1): 101, with highlighted clade Oviraptorosauria and Archaeopteryx and Confuciusornis as its outgroups.
